assets.prompt: Create one original wide editorial illustration for Privacy City, a portfolio about simulated digital permissions. Horizontal 3:2 image. Highly art-directed flat Japanese indie-animation / research-zine visual language: angular imperfect black ink contours, elongated abstract anonymous adult figures, radically simplified geometry, purposeful asymmetry, expressive cut-paper shapes. Paper off-white #f5f6f2, near-black #111719, vivid raspberry pink #d9285d ONLY, with light grey. NO green, NO blue, NO photorealism, NO soft gradients, NO polished corporate 3D, NO stock vector mascot. Scene: an abstract city of stacked doorways and windows; a small anonymous person pauses at an oversized door-shaped permission gateway, carrying a tiny phone. Five contrasting architectural apertures hint at different permission scenarios, connected by sparse angular black paths. Ground plane visible, coherent perspective but playfully compressed like experimental 2D anime. Strong silhouette, spacious cream negative space, visual weight balanced for a website hero. NO text, numbers, charts, labels, UI widgets, real people or logos. This is a conceptual editorial artwork, not a screenshot or research evidence. Edges should look authored and economical, a deliberate two-colour lithograph rather than generic AI art.

Create one original wide editorial illustration for LoopLab, a campus materials-circulation service portfolio. Horizontal 3:2 image. Flat Japanese indie-animation / research-zine illustration with angular imperfect black ink contours, elongated anonymous adult student silhouettes, economical cut-paper geometry, purposeful asymmetry and a playful campus production scene. Restrict palette to warm off-white #f5f6f2, near-black #111719, deep teal #236656, very pale grey. NO neon green, NO photorealism, NO soft gradients, NO corporate 3D, NO glossy generic AI illustration. Two students at opposite sides of a simple workbench carefully hand over one leftover geometric sheet; nearby are a stack of offcuts, a small storage pigeonhole unit and a simple route-like architectural walkway. Four or five large shapes only for background, readable hands and material silhouette, coherent planar floor. Emphasize the physical handover and reuse, not an endless abstract recycle arrow. Expressive negative space, an original ink-and-cut-paper composition, intentionally not geometrically perfect. NO text, letters, numbers, diagrams, product interface, logos, metrics. This is a clearly conceptual scene, not a photograph or evidence of a built service.

An original transparent-background editorial asset for a blue research portfolio called Growth Compass. One readable scene of two anonymous adult university students and a simple teacher/advisor figure around a sparse course-planning table. One student holds an empty rectangular course card; the other points to a few blank paper sheets arranged on the tabletop; the advisor gestures openly, not lecturing. Full figures visible with generous clear silhouette spacing. Original flat angular Japanese indie-animation / zine illustration: long limbs, expressive angular ink contours, economical black shapes, imperfect authored line rhythm, large negative spaces, deliberately not a glossy 3D mascot. Palette near-black #111719, cobalt #2357e8, pale paper #f5f6f2 only. No gradients, no photorealism, no soft corporate illustration, no drop shadow or surrounding scene, NO text, lettering, labels, numbers, UI, logos or data. Transparent background, isolated group usable inside a service-journey diagram. The people are conceptual figures, not participant portraits. Keep the course cards blank so the webpage can provide truthful labels separately.
